row.notes: Player vehicle index (byte, 0xff = none) for local player slot param_2: when a session exists ([[self+0x30]+0x88]+0x260), takes the local player's id from g 0x14604c2c8 +0x140 +0x1c0+slot*8 -> +0x1c0 vcall +0x38, searches it in the session's player list +0x2e0..+0x2e8 (stride 0x88, match 0x1431146d0) and returns entry+0x82 (car index); online it only returns it when the lobby slot ([sess+0xf88]+0x101+idx*2) is the local machine. Many callers (HUD, session states, RaceStrategyViewModel populate). (used by vmknolle red-flag-pit strategy probe)
